name: TASK: Import, Commit and Push ChessForge

messages.content:
TASK: Import, Commit and Push ChessForge to GitHub

You already have access to my connected GitHub account "Robee99".

Repository:
https://github.com/Robee99/chessforge

Target branch:
"wip/pre-push-audit-fixes"

Source project:
"ChessForge_Android_Repo (5).zip"

Instructions

1. Locate and inspect the supplied ChessForge ZIP archive.
2. Extract the project and identify its actual Flutter project root ("chessforge/").
3. Exclude the ZIP's ".git" directory. Do not import its historical Git metadata.
4. Inspect the existing GitHub repository and target branch before changing anything.
5. Preserve all existing project files and configuration. Do not overwrite working project files blindly.
6. Import the complete project into the target branch.
7. Include all required source files, Android configuration, GitHub Actions workflows, scripts, documentation and assets.
8. Do not commit generated build directories, caches, secrets, API keys or local machine configuration.
9. Check ".gitignore", "pubspec.yaml", Android Gradle configuration and GitHub Actions workflow files.
10. Run Flutter dependency resolution, formatting, static analysis and tests where the cloud environment supports them.
11. Do not silently remove failing tests or disable checks to make the build pass.
12. Commit all intended changes with message:

"Import ChessForge Android project"

13. Push the commit to:
    "origin/wip/pre-push-audit-fixes"

Critical Git safety

- NEVER push to "main".
- NEVER force-push.
- NEVER delete existing branches.
- NEVER discard existing commits or uncommitted work.
- If the remote branch contains work not present locally, fetch and reconcile safely.
- If conflicts occur, inspect and resolve them without losing either side's valid work.

After pushing

1. Confirm the commit SHA on GitHub.
2. Confirm the complete Flutter project is visible in the target branch.
3. Inspect ".github/workflows/build-apk.yml".
4. Trigger the Android APK build workflow.
5. Fix genuine build errors and retry.
6. Verify the resulting APK exists, is non-empty and is a valid Android APK.
7. Provide the direct APK download link.

Do not stop after writing a plan. Execute the import, commit, push and build. Report actual results and any blockers honestly.
